_comment: Expansion 3 part D.2: level 3 spells of the 2024 Player's Handbook (docs/expansions/03-demigods-magics.md).

aura_of_vitality.name: Aura of Vitality

again.name: Aura of Vitality: a healing
again.text: While the spell holds, a bonus action heals one friend within 30 feet for 2d6.

aura_of_vitality.text: A healing aura rolls out around you for a minute (concentration): a friend within 30 feet heals 2d6 now, and each turn a bonus action heals one more friend within 30 feet for 2d6.

beacon_of_hope.name: Beacon of Hope
beacon_of_hope.text: A light of hope on up to six friends within 30 feet (concentration, a minute): they save with advantage against Wisdom effects and against death, and every healing they receive gives the most the dice can give.

bestow_curse.name: Bestow Curse
bestow_curse.text: You touch a foe (concentration, a minute): on a failed Wisdom save it is cursed, and each of your attacks and spells that hurts it deals an extra 1d8 necrotic. The curse's other forms and the longer slots are not in the game.

blinding_smite.name: Blinding Smite
blinding_smite.text: Readied on the blow: the next melee hit adds 3d8 radiant, and the foe goes blind until it makes a Constitution save, tried at the end of each of its turns. Each higher slot adds 1d8.

blink.name: Blink
blink.text: For a minute you flicker between worlds: at the end of each of your turns a d20 of 11 or more sends you off the field until the start of your next turn, where nothing can touch you.

call_lightning.name: Call Lightning

again.name: Call Lightning: another bolt
again.text: While the spell holds, an action calls down another bolt on a point you can see: 3d10 lightning within 5 feet, Dexterity save for half.

call_lightning.text: A storm cloud gathers (concentration, ten minutes) and a bolt falls on a point up to 120 feet away: 3d10 lightning to all within 5 feet, Dexterity save for half. Each turn an action calls another. Each higher slot adds 1d10.

conjure_animals.name: Conjure Animals

again.name: Conjure Animals: the pack moves
again.text: While the spell holds, a bonus action sends the pack to a new spot; whoever it falls on must save.

conjure_animals.text: A pack of spectral beasts fills a 10-foot radius up to 60 feet away (concentration, ten minutes): all caught, or who enter or end a turn there, make a Dexterity save or take 3d10 slashing. A bonus action moves the pack. Each higher slot adds 1d10.

conjure_barrage.name: Conjure Barrage
conjure_barrage.text: You brandish your weapon and a spray of spectral copies flies out in a 60-foot cone: your foes there make a Dexterity save or take 5d8 force, half on a save. Each higher slot adds 1d8.

crusaders_mantle.name: Crusader's Mantle
crusaders_mantle.text: A holy aura spreads 30 feet around you (concentration, a minute): you and your friends in it deal an extra 1d4 radiant damage with every weapon hit.

dispel_magic.name: Dispel Magic
dispel_magic.text: You unravel the magic on a creature or a patch of ground within 120 feet: every spell on it of your slot's level or lower ends, and a higher one ends on a spellcasting check against 10 plus its level.

elemental_weapon.name: Elemental Weapon
elemental_weapon.text: A weapon you touch burns with fire (concentration, an hour): +1 to attack rolls and an extra 1d4 fire on every hit. With a slot of level 5 or 6 it is +2 and 2d4; with level 7 or more, +3 and 3d4. The other four elements are not offered.

fear.name: Fear
fear.text: A vision of dread in a 30-foot cone (concentration, a minute): everyone there makes a Wisdom save or is frightened and runs from you with its reaction, trying again at the end of each of its turns.

fly.name: Fly
fly.text: A willing creature you touch rises on the air for ten minutes (concentration): it flies at a speed of 60 feet and can hover. One more creature for each higher slot.

haste.name: Haste
haste.text: A willing creature within 30 feet moves in a blur for a minute (concentration): double speed, +2 to Armour Class, advantage on Dexterity saves and one more attack with its action. When it ends, a wave of lethargy takes it for a turn.

hunger_of_hadar.name: Hunger of Hadar
hunger_of_hadar.text: A gate to the Far Realm opens in a 20-foot radius up to 150 feet away (concentration): black, hard going. Whoever enters or starts a turn there takes 2d6 cold, and makes a Dexterity save or takes 2d6 acid.

hypnotic_pattern.name: Hypnotic Pattern
hypnotic_pattern.text: Twisting colours fill a 30-foot cube up to 120 feet away (concentration, a minute): everyone there who fails a Wisdom save stands charmed and helpless until it is hurt. It catches friends too.

lightning_arrow.name: Lightning Arrow
lightning_arrow.text: Readied on the bow: the next ranged hit turns into lightning, 4d8 more, and all within 10 feet of the target make a Dexterity save or take 2d8 lightning, half on a save. Each higher slot adds 1d8 to both.

protection_from_energy.name: Protection from Energy
protection_from_energy.text: A willing creature you touch resists one kind of energy for an hour (concentration): acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder, whichever the foes here deal most.

sleet_storm.name: Sleet Storm
sleet_storm.text: Freezing sleet falls in a 20-foot radius up to 150 feet away (concentration, a minute): the ground is slippery going, and the air is thick. Whoever enters or starts a turn there makes a Dexterity save or falls prone.

slow.name: Slow
slow.text: Time drags in a 40-foot cube up to 120 feet away (concentration, a minute): foes there make a Wisdom save or move at half speed, with -2 to Armour Class and Dexterity saves, no bonus action and one attack an action, saving again each turn.

stinking_cloud.name: Stinking Cloud
stinking_cloud.text: A sickly yellow cloud fills a 20-foot radius up to 90 feet away (concentration, a minute): thick air. Whoever starts a turn there makes a Constitution save or retches, poisoned, and loses its action and bonus action that turn.

vampiric_touch.name: Vampiric Touch

again.name: Vampiric Touch: another touch
again.text: While the spell holds, an action touches again: a melee spell attack for 3d6 necrotic, and you heal half the damage.

vampiric_touch.text: Your shadowed hand drinks life (concentration, a minute): a melee spell attack for 3d6 necrotic, and you heal half of it. Each turn an action touches again. Each higher slot adds 1d6.

wind_wall.name: Wind Wall
wind_wall.text: A wall of strong wind rises along a 50-foot line (concentration, a minute): everyone in it makes a Strength save or takes 4d8 bludgeoning, half on a save, and arrows and bolts cannot cross it. Each higher slot adds 1d8.
